title: Story premise EDU020: The Marble That Cannot Climb Home
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: Why does the second hill keep winning? Takeaway/theme: Friction changes how energy is distributed and limits mechanical motion.
description: A marble needs to reach its starting height after rolling through a rough valley, but slows before the far summit. An energy-accounting overlay includes frictional transfer instead of inventing missing energy.
